posts.body_html:
Here's the beginning of a thread to document this complex "hybrid" involving two giant roseas being mixed together! So far, the seedings are 2-3X the size compared to other rosea crosses sown at the same exact time and grown under identical conditions.

So first, lets take a look at the parents, here's the mother plant, red throat giant:
